subject: release-tooling/durable-failure-learning
statement: A release/recovery failure that required root-cause diagnosis and produced a reusable prevention rule is not fully closed until that invariant is represented in durable project knowledge. Fix + tests alone are insufficient when the lesson applies to future work.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Dogfood Agent DevTools by converting proven R6/R6.1 release and recovery failure lessons into durable project knowledge.
